description: Makes the plan for the book and returns the link to the order form on the website with the occasion and story line filled in. The parent then enters the child's name and photo there.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the user writes in, e.g. 'en', 'nl', 'de'
language.title: Language

occasion.description: Occasion id from list_occasions, e.g. 'verjaardag' or 'kerst'
occasion.title: Occasion

story.description: Story line id from list_occasions; empty for the best one
story.title: Story

style.description: Style id from show_styles, if the user chose one
style.title: Style

name: create_book_plan
title: Book plan and order form
